pattern: echo "--- перезапуск production-шима с логированием ---" systemctl --user restart justwoker-shim.service sleep 3 echo "health=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8787/health)" curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8787/health jq -r '.justwoker.key' ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json echo "--- большой payload через production (с логами) ---" curl -s -o /tmp/opencode/jw/big-resp.json -w "http=%{http_code} t=%{time_total}s\n" --max-time 240 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/messages -H "x-api-key: $KEY" -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" -H "content-type: application/json" -d @/tmp/opencode/jw/big.json echo "--- ответ ---" head -c 200 /tmp/opencode/jw/big-resp.json echo echo "--- логи шима (после запроса) ---" journalctl --user -u justwoker-shim --since "1 min ago" --no-pager 2>/dev/null tail -10
